title: Staff Product Marketing Manager
searchText: Staff Product Marketing Manager MongoDB As a Staff Product Marketing Manager, you are in a high-impact role responsible for critical product areas and strategic initiatives. You aren’t just executing a roadmap. You are defining the marketing strategy for your area by focusing on the large-scale business picture. You will navigate high degrees of ambiguity to deliver results independently, serving as a strategic partner to leaders across the business. The right candidate can dive deep into data and technical details while simultaneously conveying high-level strategies to the executive team. You will work with leaders across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to build go-to-market (GTM) strategies and successfully assemble cross-functional teams to execute derivative marketing and enablement tactics. You will act as a key partner to senior leadership to influence and drive consensus with teams across the company. We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in New York City, NY for our hybrid working model. What You'll Do Own Strategy & Execution: Act as the directly responsible individual for high-impact product areas, defining end-to-end marketing and enablement strategies that align with MongoDB’s long-term business goals Drive GTM Excellence: Develop data-driven GTM strategies including positioning, messaging, and persona development. You will advise teams on the best marketing and enablement techniques to persuade diverse audiences Solve Complex Problems: Identify and decompose intrinsically hard problems within the business. You will pressure-test strategic assumptions, identify gaps in GTM motions, and drive cross-functional consensus Act as a Strategic Consultant: Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders. You will be expected to present clear plans, narratives, and risk assessments that influence the direction of the organization Mentor and Amplify: Raise the bar for the entire Product Marketing organization by sharing best practices, streamlining processes, and aligning all work to business objectives. You will actively mentor other team members to accelerate their growth We’re Excited About You Because Proven experience in product marketing, preferably in B2B technology, cloud, or enterprise software, with a strong track record of success A demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, where you are given a high-level business outcome to achieve, and trusted to develop and execute the strategy Proven ability to bring strong, data-driven judgment to decisions, with a keen ability to assess risk tradeoffs and drive clarity Consensus-building and high-bar communication (both verbal and written), capable of influencing the priorities of cross-functional teams and senior leaders. You should be excited to deliver your perspectives and progress to the senior leadership team Deep understanding of the fundamentals of technology (ideally databases, cloud infrastructure, the developer landscape, and how they are connected to new technologies like generative AI) and can effectively connect a product area to its business impact. This role is not expected to be a technical practitioner, but must develop the technical depth necessary to effectively market MongoDB’s offerings and communicate with practitioners Genuine empathy for customer challenges and pain points, with the ability to understand the common use cases and implementation specifics that customers are facing A strong bias for action and the ability to decompose complex problems into effective solutions and drive execution cross-functionally Excellent judgment and comfortable navigating executive-level escalations Ability to effectively represent the company as a subject matter expert in executive-level customer calls, analyst briefings, and public appearances About MongoDB MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the database for the AI era, enabling innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified database platform—the most widely available, globally distributed database on the market—helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. With offices worldwide and nearly 60,000 customers—including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups—relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software. Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy , we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world! MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. MongoDB, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type and makes all hiring decisions without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Req ID: 4263333883 MongoDB’s base salary range for this role is posted below. Compensation at the time of offer is unique to each candidate and based on a variety of factors such as skill set, experience, qualifications, and work location. Salary is one part of MongoDB’s total compensation and benefits package. Other benefits for eligible employees may include: equity, participation in the employee stock purchase program, flexible paid time off, 20 weeks fully-paid gender-neutral parental leave, fertility and adoption assistance, 401(k) plan, mental health counseling, access to transgender-inclusive health insurance coverage, and health benefits offerings. Please note, the base salary range listed below and the benefits in this paragraph are only applicable to U.S.-based candidates. MongoDB’s base salary range for this role in the U.S. is: $104,000 — $204,000 USD As a Staff Product Marketing Manager, you are in a high-impact role responsible for critical product areas and strategic initiatives.
